feature: Extend symbol extraction (acronym CamelCase + lowerCamelCase) and remove --first-parent from pickaxe
problem: 3 Recall@100 failures are caused by: (1) CamelCase regex misses acronym identifiers like HiveUDAF (SPARK-27907), (2) regex misses lowerCamelCase like globalTempDB (SPARK-23059), (3) pickaxe --first-parent misses commits via merged PRs (SPARK-946). Diagnostic P21.2 proved all 3 are rescuable.
proposed_solution: Add two new regexes to problem_extractor.py for acronym CamelCase and lowerCamelCase symbols. Remove --first-parent from pickaxe in git_search.py. Filter file inference to PascalCase only (lowerCamelCase shouldn't generate filenames). Scope updated from original P22 based on diagnostic findings — keyword_grep symbol feeding dropped (diagnostic showed symbols don't appear in commit messages).
acceptance_criteria: AC3: _extract_symbols('use globalTempDB and listTables') includes 'globalTempDB' and 'listTables'
AC4: _extract_symbols('call dropTempView and dropGlobalTempView') includes both
AC6: Existing PascalCase symbols (RouteBuilder, CqlPagingRecordReader, HistoryServer) still extracted — no regression
AC7: Short noise like 'aBC' or single-segment words NOT extracted (min length 6 or structural filter)
AC9: _infer_files_from_symbols only generates filenames for PascalCase symbols (not lowerCamelCase)
AC10: All existing tests pass with no behavioral regression
edge_cases: EC1: Symbol preceded by dot (obj.HiveUDAF) should NOT match (word boundary preserved)
EC2: Symbol inside a URL or file path should not produce false lowerCamelCase matches
EC3: Empty text returns empty symbol list (both new regexes)
verification_method: Evaluator should: (1) Read problem_extractor.py and verify both new regexes are correct with boundary guards. (2) Verify git_search.py pickaxe has no --first-parent. (3) Verify _infer_files_from_symbols filters lowerCamelCase. (4) Run pytest -v and verify all tests pass. (5) Manually test regex patterns against the diagnostic examples.
